title: K.K. Benson, Soviet Employee

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGD. 585
Date May Date 2. 1. 1934
Subject (in full) K. K. Benson, Soviet Employee.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名] D.I.
Karl Karlovitch Benson, 41, U.S.S.R. citizen, employee of
Centrosojus, arrived at Shanghai from Moscow via Kobe, Japan,
on April 17, 1934, by the s.s. "President Grant". He holds
U.S.S.R. passport No. 119724/23564 issued in Moscow. Benson
resides at the New Asia Hotel, North Szechuen Road, Room 325.
[签名]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
（左侧批注：Jrl / 28）
